verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents vector indexes that need a dimension and a distance metric, and it offers approximate vector search. Nothing in the evidence mentions vector quantization, compression, or any documented accuracy trade-off for cutting memory or storage cost. The axis applies to a vector-capable database, so the lack of evidence makes this "none".

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off
